title: Dream Payments Redesigned Their Brand & Product UX and Raised $11.9M
deckSource: Pattern = Lateral deck title card (eyebrow · headline · one line · visual). Copy word for word from the source-traced draft: headline = step / milestone title, line = its item, eyebrow = its "when" or "Brand Engineering" (solution body).

deckSlides.title: Discovery
deckSlides.text: We kicked off the engagement by understanding Dream's current UX, brand challenges, and market expansion goals.

deckSlides.title: Overhaul of Their Product UX
deckSlides.text: We designed a user experience flow that aligned with U.S. market expectations and clearly communicated Dream's value to new users and stakeholders.

deckSlides.title: Design
deckSlides.text: We applied a modern, premium visual identity across all core assets

deckSlides.title: Full Website Redesign

deckSlides.title: Development
